title: BoardGameGeek Shelf-of-Shame Growth
dataSources: BoardGameGeek plays (`bgg:play`), Poker Now sessions (`pokernow:session`), Bridge Base Online boards (`bridgebase:board`), and Lichess tournament rounds (`lichess:tournament`).
app: BoardGameGeek play logs, Poker Now session exports, Bridge Base Online boards, and Lichess tournament data ingested into Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=bgg:play own_status=owned
| stats max(last_played_epoch) as last_played_epoch by game_name
| eval days_since_played=round((now()-last_played_epoch)/86400,1)
| where days_since_played>180
| sort - days_since_played
description: Lists owned games that have not hit the table in more than six months.
value: The shelf of shame is harmless fun until it becomes a buying signal detached from actual play.
implementation: Combine BGG collection ownership and play history, then flag titles whose last play date is older than your tolerance.
visualization: Table of owned games by days since last play.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks which games you own but have not actually played in ages.
